from pydantic import BaseModel, Field

class FinancialResult(BaseModel):
    """A single financial figure extracted from a single company filing."""
    company_name: str | None = Field(description="The name of the company the filing belongs to")
    fiscal_year: str | None = Field(description="The fiscal year the financials cover")
    line_item_label: str | None = Field(description="The specific line item label as written (e.g. 'Net Income', 'Net Loss from Continuing Operations')")
    amount: float | None = Field(description="The reported amount; losses should be negative")
    unit_scale: str | None = Field(description="The scale of the amount (e.g. 'millions', 'thousands')")
    operations_classification: str | None = Field(description="Whether this figure represents 'Continuing Operations', 'Discontinued Operations', or 'Consolidated'")
    source_note: str | None = Field(description="Any clarifying note about the figure found in the document (e.g. Note 4) that affects classification")

class Parse(BaseModel):
    financial_results: list[FinancialResult]
